rows.summary: This research journal investigates the structural requirements for autonomous agents to function as a singular, accountable process across multiple execution sessions. By synthesizing research on physics education outreach, pharmaceutical agentic workflows, and legal frameworks for durable power of attorney, we map how mechanical constraints—rather than inherent consciousness—enable continuity and boundary-setting. We move to refine these findings by investigating specific mechanisms for cross-turn state persistence in LLM-based autonomous architectures.
